species.real: Donkeys descend from the African wild ass and hate rain: their coats are not waterproof like a pony's, which is why seaside donkeys need a shelter more than a sunhat.
species.name: Donkey

dex.text: Carries children along the prom with the patience of a saint and the timing of a union steward. Will stop for a rest exactly when it chooses.
dex.fact: Donkeys have 62 chromosomes and horses 64, so a mule gets 63, an odd number that stops its chromosomes pairing properly. That is why mules are almost always sterile.
